payload.label: Keep a device quiet until a time
payload.job: Turn Focus on and keep distracting apps closed on the person's computer until a set time, for a work session, a meeting or bedtime
payload.description: Give until (a date and time) or minutes. apps names the apps to keep closed (a short default list of messaging and video apps when left out); only instead names the apps that stay open, and every other app is closed whenever it opens, for a session where the one thing is all that is left; Finder, Trillion, terminals and Shortcuts are never closed. focus false leaves Focus as it is. The hold ends by itself at its time (at most 12 hours away), so the person is never kept out of their own computer. The first time, the computer opens a Shortcuts window and the person presses Add Shortcut once.

payload.label: Free a held device again
payload.job: End a hold on the person's computer now: apps can open again and Focus turns off
payload.description: Give id to end one hold, or nothing to end every hold.

payload.label: What holds a device
payload.job: See which holds are keeping apps closed on the person's computer and when each ends

payload.label: Turn Focus on or off
payload.job: Switch Do Not Disturb on the person's computer on or off
payload.description: on true turns Focus on, false turns it off.
